clips.actions: async()=>{await p.getByRole('button',{name:/Scan Card OCR/}).click();const selectCard=p.getByText('Select Card Image',{exact:true});await selectCard.waitFor();const chooser=p.waitForEvent('filechooser');await selectCard.click();await (await chooser).setFiles(resolve(out,'synthetic-test-card.png'));await p.getByText('Extracted — review details',{exact:true}).waitFor();await pause(800);}

limitations: Synthetic in-memory API; no production patient data
Staff and patient demonstrations use separate synthetic records
All five AI demonstrations display authentic Gemini inference from purpose-made synthetic inputs using the implemented feature prompts and schemas; backend database routes were bypassed.
OCR source is a synthetic card clearly marked NOT VALID; extracted values require human review.
HMO appeal is an unsubmitted draft; claims audit is an assessment for staff review; Cora explains only the synthetic account ledger.
No discharge pass exists in fixture; documents slot shows actual documents
Dashboard mutations blocked; no live insurer verification
